What Our Guests Say

In an era of rushed takeaway cups and distracted days, Chiya ko Charcha was founded to restore the timeless ritual of unhurried tea drinking. Along Baniyatar Road, we have built a nook where time eases up.

Whether you are sitting with a notebook under soft morning sunshine, working remotely with hot milk tea by your side, or sharing laughter with long-time friends after evening work hours — you belong at our table.

Get in touch ↗
Where is the café?

Find Chiya ko Charcha on Baniyatar Road in Tokha, Bagmati Province 44600, Nepal. Visit the Contact page for directions.

How do I order online?

Add items from the menu to your bag, review your order, then send the request through WhatsApp. Orders are confirmed by the café.

Can I ask about allergies or ingredients?

Yes. Call +977 980-8836939 before ordering to discuss ingredients and preparation with the team.

Can I arrange a group visit?

Please call the café to check seating and availability before bringing a group.

Is payment taken on the website?

No payment is collected here. Confirm payment options and any delivery charges directly with the café.
